name: Háma
subtitle: Doorward of Théoden
game_text:
To play, spot a <culture>Rohan</culture> Man.
<phase>Skirmish</phase>: Exert Háma to discard a possession borne by a minion he is skirmishing.
flavor_text: “‘Yet in doubt a man of worth will trust to his own wisdom. I believe you are friends and folk worthy of honour, who have no evil purpose.’”
